notes_my: Fix: data screens showed 'ဒေတာ ဖွင့်၍မရပါ။' on real devices. The WebView was missing setAllowFileAccessFromFileURLs / setAllowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs, so fetch() of the app's own data/*.json from file:///android_asset/ was blocked on Android (worked only over http in tests). No UI changes.
